title: Smoky Chicken and Pepper Penne
changes_from_base: Seared cumin and smoked-paprika chicken and soft sweet peppers replace the chilli tomato sauce, finished with oregano and cool yoghurt.
summary: Penne with seared cumin and smoked-paprika chicken, soft sweet peppers and fresh oregano, served with cool yoghurt.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 2.5 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken thighs, sliced 1 cm thick
fine sea salt or table salt
small red, yellow or orange peppers, in 1 cm strips
jalapeño, seeded and cut into strips
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the penne in 3 litres salted water until al dente. Save about 80 ml of the water and drain.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Toss the slices with half the cumin and paprika, the salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in the pan over high heat until it shimmers, add the chicken in one layer and cook about 5 min, turning now and then, until golden and 74 °C inside. The oil turns red from the paprika and carries the flavour into the pasta later. Lift the chicken onto a plate.

steps.title: Peppers
steps.text: Turn the heat to medium, add the rest of the oil, the peppers, jalapeño and the second lot of salt. Cook 10 min, tossing, until soft but holding their shape. Add the garlic and the remaining cumin and paprika for 1 min, then the vinegar.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the penne, the saved water and the chicken and toss until glossy and hot. Off the heat, toss in the oregano so it just wilts, and serve with spoonfuls of yoghurt.

tips: Cut the chicken evenly so every piece cooks at the same rate.
Leave the jalapeño seeds in for more heat.
Add the oregano off the heat so it stays fresh.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
